repos_data.description: Self-hosted bookmark manager that is designed be to be minimal, fast, and easy to set up using Docker.
A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search

repo_meta_data.description: An open source, self-hosted platform for sharing and managing your most frequently used links. Easily create customizable, human-readable shortcuts to streamline your link management.
